first_community: Wardle's family group chat -> New Zealand Twitter
narrative: Built 2020 for partner; public Oct 2021. 90 players Nov 1. Family chat, a mention in an NYT newsletter footnote, then big in NZ where a player invented the emoji grid. Share button shipped 2021-12-16. 300k players Jan 2; NYT profile Jan 3 then celebrities; ~2M mid-Jan; sold Jan 31.

13 reviews May-Oct 2013; Sept bug-fix update; first tweet Nov 4; US game charts Nov (#1,368); top 250 free Dec 13 as frustrated tweets begin; top 10 Jan 10; #1 Jan 17; PewDiePie video Jan 27; pulled Feb 9. No marketing. Bot accusations never substantiated.

first_community: UK App Store (Game of the Week)
narrative: Published by Chillingo Dec 2009 with little attention; UK App Store Game of the Week Feb 11 2010 lifted it from ~#600 to #1; US followed.
Launched Jul 2009; founders say growth already inflecting before John Mayer tweeted it was 'the new Twitter' on Oct 5 2009.
Facebook Apr 2012 (King had 15M DAU network), mobile Nov 2012; King states it seeds viral channels with paid acquisition; DAU 15M->124M during 2013.
Launched Jun 19 2009 on Facebook with Zynga cross-promo; 1M new DAU per week; 11M DAU at 9 weeks. Facebook curtailed app notifications in early 2010 and Zynga DAU fell 67M->48M.
Launched Feb 6 2012; 50M downloads in ~50 days; ~14.3M DAU Apr 2; -33% within a month; Zynga bought OMGPOP Mar 21 for $183.1M and impaired $95.5M by Q3.
Weekend fork of 1024 (itself a Threes clone), posted on Hacker News Mar 9 2014; open-source forks multiplied.
Premium $1.99 launch Feb 6 2014 to acclaim; free clones 1024 (Feb 27) and 2048 (Mar 9) eclipsed it within weeks.

first_community: South Korean and Brazilian streamers -> Sodapoppin (Twitch)
narrative: Released Jun 2018, low double-digit players for most of first year; streamers in Korea/Brazil then Sodapoppin from Jul 15 2020 (Twitch avg viewers 460 -> 53k); 1.5M CCU Sep 5 2020.
Switch eShop Japan Dec 2021 (clone of Chinese web game Merge Big Watermelon); exploded Sep 2023 after streamers; sales up 50,000x; 4M+ downloads.
